# pvecli tag add

Add or update a tag color in the cluster.

```text
pvecli tag add [TAG] [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `TAG` | Tag name. |

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-cl`, `--color VALUE` | Hex color (e.g. ff4444). |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
